wargearItems.name: Vox Caster
effects: Units equipped with a Vox Caster can receive Orders that are issued by a unit equipped with a Master Vox from anywhere on the battlefield, including while embarked in a Transport.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Units equipped with a Vox Caster can receive Orders that are issued by a unit equipped with a Master Vox from anywhere on the battlefield, including while embarked in a Transport.

wargearItems.name: Master Vox
effects: Units equipped with a Master Vox can issue Orders to any eligible unit on the battlefield equipped with a Vox Caster. Additionally, once per battle, this unit can issue 1 Order to be in effect for an additional 2 Regiment units when using the Platoon Command ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Units equipped with a Master Vox can issue Orders to any eligible unit on the battlefield equipped with a Vox Caster. Additionally, once per battle, this unit can issue 1 Order to be in effect for an additional 2 Regiment units when using the Platoon Command ability.

wargearItems.name: Regimental Standard
effects: Friendly Astra Militarum units that can draw line of sight to the bearer, and who have at least 1 model within 12" of the bearer, change their Leadership characteristic to 5+.
While the bearer is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of a Primary Objective Marker, it is considered to have an Objective Control value of 30.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Friendly Astra Militarum units that can draw line of sight to the bearer, and who have at least 1 model within 12" of the bearer, change their Leadership characteristic to 5+.

While the bearer is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of a Primary Objective Marker, it is considered to have an Objective Control value of 30.

wargearItems.name: Medi-kit
effects: While a model equipped with a Medi-kit is on the battlefield it is eligible to use one of the following abilities during your Command Phase:
Roll a D3 and return the number of lost wounds equal to the resulting value.

Roll a D6. On a roll of a 4 or higher, return a destroyed Character to the unit with 2 Wounds remaining. This ability can only be used when a Character from this unit has been destroyed in the previous Battle Round.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
While a model equipped with a Medi-kit is on the battlefield it is eligible to use one of the following abilities during your Command Phase:

  • Roll a D3 and return the number of lost wounds equal to the resulting value.
  • Roll a D6. On a roll of a 4 or higher, return a destroyed Character to the unit with 2 Wounds remaining. This ability can only be used when a Character from this unit has been destroyed in the previous Battle Round.

wargearItems.name: Relic Weapon
effects: Cannot be used on Grenade weapons
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase weapon's Attacks characteristic by 1
  • Increase weapon's Strength characteristic by 1
  • Increase weapon's Damage characteristic by 1
  • Cannot be used on Grenade weapons

wargearItems.name: Refractor Field
effects: Models equipped with a Refractor Field:
Increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Refractor Field:

  • Increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability

wargearItems.name: Rosarius
effects: Increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Rosarius:

  • Increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Cavalry Mount
effects: Models equipped with a Cavalry Mount:
Cannot be selected by models equipped with any of the following: Carapace Armour, Camo Cloak
Models equipped with a Cavalry Mount cannot be equipped with weapons that possess the Heavy keyword unless that weapon also possesses the Pistol keyword.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Cavalry Mount:

  • Gain the Mounted keyword
  • Increase Movement characteristic to 12"
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 4+
  • Cannot be selected by models equipped with any of the following: Carapace Armour, Camo Cloak
  • Models equipped with a Cavalry Mount cannot be equipped with weapons that possess the Heavy keyword unless that weapon also possesses the Pistol keyword.

wargearItems.name: Carapace Armour
effects: Upgrade must be selected for every model in the unit.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Upgrade must be selected for every model in the unit.
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 4+.

wargearItems.name: Bullgryn Plate
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 3+.

wargearItems.name: Brute Shield
effects: Models equipped with a Brute Shield:
Reduce the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Brute Shield:

  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability
  • Reduce the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)

wargearItems.name: Slab Shield
effects: Models equipped with a Slab Shield:
Increase their Armour Save characteristic to 3+
Reduce the Armour Piercing characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 0)
Reduce the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with a Slab Shield:

  • Reduce their Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Reduce their Initiative characteristic by 1
  • Reduce their Attacks characteristic by 2
  • Add 1 to their Toughness characteristic
  • Add 3 to their Wounds characteristic
  • Increase their Armour Save characteristic to 3+
  • Reduce the Armour Piercing characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 0)
  • Reduce the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)

wargearItems.name: Camo Cloak
effects: Enemy models making Ranged attacks against a model equipped with a Camo Cloak reduce their Ballistic Skill by 1 whilst the model equipped with a Camo Cloak is wholly positioned within a Terrain Feature.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Enemy models making Ranged attacks against a model equipped with a Camo Cloak reduce their Ballistic Skill by 1 whilst the model equipped with a Camo Cloak is wholly positioned within a Terrain Feature.

effects: Upgrade must be selected for every model in the unit.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Upgrade must be selected for every model in the unit.

wargearItems.name: Auspex Scanner

wargearItems.effectsHtml: Units equipped with an Auspex Scanner ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against enemy units with that ability.

wargearItems.name: Battlemutt

wargearItems.effectsHtml: Add 1 to this unit's Hymns of Battle roll.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.

Improve their Breach Test roll by 1
Do not reduce their Movement characteristic by 2" when moving through Difficult Ground
wargearItems.effectsHtml:

wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with a Searchlight ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against enemy units with that ability.
